He dared developers to build a competitor. Then his startup crossed $1B in annualized revenue. Smart or reckless? 🤔

Alex Mashrabov, CEO of Higgsfield, put it in one tweet: «Go build your own Higgsfield.»

Higgsfield hit $1B in annualized revenue, 18 months after launch, 20x growth in a single year, from $50M to $1B.

What’s open: pipelines, skills, and 50+ models through one API. SDKs, a CLI, and plugins under MIT and Apache licenses.

What’s behind the growth: enterprise adoption up over 100% month-over-month, 300% net revenue retention, and 70% of revenue now coming from creative agencies instead of individual creators.

The models and platform stay proprietary. What’s on GitHub is the tooling, and it still needs a paid API key to generate anything.
